# Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pm Bi)

**ID:** Pm Bi
**Section:** Pātimokkha (pm)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

A dedicated classical commentary on the code is found in Buddhaghosa's *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī* [Nakamura 1980].

Text-reuse and parallel analyses demonstrate extensive shared material across Buddhist Vinaya traditions. DharmaNexus registers substantial internal Pali reuse, notably with the *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha*, individual chapters of the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* (such as the *Saṅghādisesa* sections), the *Parivāra* (*Katthapaññattivāra* and *Katāpattivāra*), and later subcommentaries including the *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali, cross-language matches connect the text directly to non-Theravāda counterparts, including Sanskrit *Prātimokṣasūtra* and *Bhikṣuṇīvinaya* manuscripts, as well as the Tibetan Kangyur *Bhikṣuṇīprātimokṣasūtra* (D 4) and related Vinaya commentaries [DharmaNexus]. Modern English translations of the Theravāda text include that by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
